# 3. NEEDS ANALYSIS

**Motor Vehicle Insurance**

Test User requires motor vehicle insurance to protect against financial loss arising from damage to, or liability caused by, their vehicle. The identified need encompasses comprehensive coverage for accidental damage, theft, hijacking, and third-party liability exposure. At a premium of R20,000 per annum, the client seeks adequate indemnity limits and an excess structure proportionate to their risk tolerance and financial capacity. The motor insurance requirement is foundational to managing personal transportation risk and satisfies legal compliance obligations under the Road Traffic Act.

---

# 4. MARKET COMPARISON

Market Comparison - Not applicable - this is a New Policy placement and insufficient multi-insurer quotation data has been provided to conduct a genuine comparative analysis. Only Santam premium information (R20,000 per annum) has been presented. A full market comparison exercise requires documented quotations from a minimum of three competing insurers with equivalent benefit structures, excess levels, and limits of indemnity. To ensure compliance with FAIS Act section 6(3)(d) and Board Notice 80 obligations, the client should be advised that a comprehensive market comparison can be undertaken upon request, which would involve obtaining formal written quotations from competing providers and documenting the rationale for product selection against those alternatives.

---

# 5. PRODUCT RECOMMENDED

**Recommended Insurer:** Santam Limited (Annual Premium: R20,000)

**Motor Vehicle Insurance Product – Comprehensive Cover**

The recommended product is Santam's Comprehensive Motor Vehicle Insurance policy, selected on the basis of documented quotation provided and suitability to the client's identified needs for comprehensive accidental damage, theft, hijacking, and third-party liability protection.

**Section 9(1) Statutory Product Detail:**

• Insurer: Santam Limited, FSP License No. 627
• Premium: R20,000 per annum
• Cover Type: Comprehensive Motor Vehicle Insurance
• Policy Period: 12 months from inception
• Benefit: Indemnity for accidental damage, theft, hijacking, third-party bodily injury and property damage liability
• Sum Insured: To be confirmed by client instruction and vehicle valuation
• Excess Structure: Standard excess of R5,000 on accidental damage claims; additional voluntary excess acceptance available at client election; nil excess on theft/hijacking subject to policy terms
• Third-Party Liability Limit: Minimum R5 million in accordance with Road Traffic Act requirements
• Geographic Scope: Republic of South Africa and SADC region as per policy wording

**Exclusions (Material Non-Exhaustive List):**

• Claims arising from unlawful use, racing, or speed trials
• Damage caused by mechanical or electrical breakdown unrelated to insured peril
• Driving under influence of alcohol or drugs
• Claims by or on behalf of unlicensed or uninsured drivers
• Wear and tear, maintenance, or depreciation
• Consequential loss, business interruption, or loss of earnings
• Unattended vehicle loss or theft not reported to police within 48 hours
• Claims arising from non-disclosure or misrepresentation of material facts
• Driving by persons not named in the schedule or not meeting age/experience requirements specified in the policy
• Claims excluded under the detailed policy wording section on exclusions

**SASRIA Cover:**

Santam Comprehensive Motor policies provide cover for loss or damage caused by civil unrest, public disorder, malicious acts, and acts of terrorism via SASRIA indemnity, subject to applicable limits and excesses. SASRIA cover is standard inclusion. The client is advised to review the specific SASRIA schedule and limits of indemnity applicable to their policy.

**Cooling-Off Period:**

The client has a 30-day cooling-off period from policy inception during which the policy may be cancelled without penalty, in accordance with the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008.

---

# 6. REMUNERATION AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION

**Broker Remuneration:**

This Record of Advice is provided by [Broker Name], FSP License No. [Broker FSP Number], operating under the supervision of the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA).

• Commission earned by the broker on this placement: To be determined by Santam's underwriting acceptance and scheduled commission percentage, typically in the range of 10–15% of annual premium (exact rate subject to Santam's current commission schedule and broker-specific arrangements).
• No additional or non-standard fee has been charged to the client beyond the stated premium.
• Commission is earned only upon policy inception and payment of premium by the client.

**Conflicts of Interest:**

• The broker maintains commercial relationships with multiple insurers, including Santam Limited, and earns commission on placements with each underwriter.
• No conflict of interest specific to this recommendation has been identified. The recommendation to proceed with Santam is based solely on the quotation provided and alignment with identified client needs, not on commission differential or commercial incentive.
• The client has the right to request a full market comparison exercise involving three or more competing insurers. Should the client wish to exercise this right, the broker will obtain formal written quotations and document comparative analysis before final product selection.
• The broker confirms that no remuneration, benefit, or incentive other than standard commission has been offered, received, or anticipated in connection with this advice.
• The client may request disclosure of the broker's commission rate in writing at any time.

**Disclosure Authority:**

This disclosure is made in compliance with FAIS Act section 6(3)(g), Board Notice 80 paragraphs 4 and 5, and the FSP's General Complaints and Conflicts of Interest Policy.

---

# 7. REPLACEMENT ADVICE

**Not Applicable**

This is a new policy placement. No existing motor vehicle insurance policy is being replaced or cancelled. The client has not advised of prior insurance arrangements to be superseded by this recommendation.

Should the client hold an existing motor vehicle insurance policy with another insurer that they intend to replace with the Santam policy recommended herein, the client is strongly advised to:

• Review the cooling-off period and cancellation provisions of the existing policy to avoid premium forfeiture
• Confirm that no gap in cover exists between cancellation of the previous policy and inception of the Santam policy
• Notify the previous insurer in writing of the cancellation request and intended effective date
• Retain all documentation relating to the cancellation to avoid disputes

---
